svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)
The enclosing frame is m_aes128_batch_top. All internal blocks use CLK-CORE. N is PARA_AES_LANE_NUM. Only ECB, CTR, and CBC decipher use N independent blocks of one message; feedback modes serialize.
One message context feeds a parameterized N-lane AES pipeline. Feedback modes serialize dependent blocks.
CFG, CFGR, DIN, DACK, DOUT, BACK,
Stores one message context; checks batch masks and message boundaries; manages handshakes.
CTX, CFG, CFGR, DIN, DACK, ERR,
Applies mode input/output transforms and updates feedback state.
Assigns consecutive CTR values to active lanes and detects field exhaustion.
Contains PARA_AES_LANE_NUM statically generated AES-128 pipeline lanes.
Preserves result order and holds an output batch under backpressure.
Aborts outstanding work, flushes valid state, and clears sensitive registers.
external -> TOP: i_cfg_valid, i_cfg_key, i_cfg_mode, i_cfg_decipher, i_cfg_iv, i_cfg_cfb_segment_size
u_aes128_ctr_ctrl -> u_aes128_mode_ctrl: one counter block per active CTR lane
message mode, direction, key, IV, segment size, last/mask metadata
external -> TOP: i_batch_valid, i_batch_data, i_batch_lane_valid, i_batch_last
TOP -> external: o_batch_valid, o_batch_data, o_batch_lane_valid, o_batch_last
N final mode results and updated chaining state
